## Enterprise pattern: partner order API

A partner sends a business JSON document. The workflow validates the contract and approved SAP catalog, converts the order into a complete `ORDERS05`, submits it with an idempotency key derived from the external order reference and returns HTTP 202 with a traceable transport receipt.

Repeated delivery of the same body is safe. A changed body under the same reference is rejected by the idempotency contract.
